title: Foundry evaluation suite
description: A reusable evaluation definition (dataset + evaluators + options). Agents reference suites by name via their evaluation-suites[] field. Depends on: evaluators[] and datasets[] must be resolved before evaluation-suites (suites reference them by name). Items in an evaluation-suites array may be inline or a $ref to an external file.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this suite validates.

dataset.description: Name of a dataset declared in datasets[].

evaluators.description: Names of evaluators declared in evaluators[]. Builtin evaluators (e.g., 'builtin.task_adherence') may be referenced without a top-level declaration.

EvalOptions.description: Execution options for evaluation or optimization. Known keys include eval_model, max_samples, trace_days, optimization_model, optimization_config, max_candidates, and evaluation_level, but any key-value pair is accepted.
